# dataset-amazon_trustpilot_reviews

This repository contains a dataset file `amazon_com_reviews_trustpilot_20261017_anon.feather` with all available English Trustpilot reviews for Amazon.com on October 17, 2026. The first review is from August 27, 2007, while the last one is from October 17, 2026. This amounts to 32,666 reviews.

## Variables

The following seven variables are available:

1. `User_ID`: an `int` column, giving the unique user ID; the same ID means that reviews were written by the same user.

2. `Date`: a `chr` column giving the date in `%Y-%m-%d` format, on which the review was published.

3. `User_Name`: a `chr` column giving the user name of the review author; a user name is not unique; note that user names have been anonymized in comparison to the original data.

4. `User_Country`: a `chr` column giving the country of the review author in alpha-2 ISO 3166 format.

5. `Review_Score`: an `int` column giving the score of the review; is always an integer from 1 through 5.

6. `Review_Title`: a `chr` column giving the title of the review.

7. `Review_Sentences`: a column with lists; each lists contains the individual sentences as `chr` entries of a review in correct order.


## Distribution information

The distribution of scores in the entire dataset is as depicted in Figure \@ref(fig:scores).

```{r scores, fig.cap="Distribution of English Amazon.com Trustpilot scores between August 27, 2007, and October 17, 2026.", echo = FALSE, out.width = "80%", out.height = "80%", fig.align='center'}
knitr::include_graphics("score_distribution.png")
```

```{r, echo = FALSE}
cat(paste0(
  "Score key numbers:\n",
  "******************\n",
  "Number of obs.     32666\n",
  "Mean                1.96\n",
  "Standard deviation  1.56\n",
  "Minimum             1.00\n",
  "1st Quartile        1.00\n",
  "Median              1.00\n",
  "3rd Quartile        3.00\n",
  "Maximum             5.00\n"
))
```

